description: Bakery Style, Brown Butter, Chocolate Chip Cookies 🍪🥰 Ingredients: • 115g butter • 160g light brown sugar • 40g granulated sugar • 1 large egg • 2tsp vanilla extract • 320g plain flour • Itsp baking powder • Itsp bicarbonate of soda • a pinch of salt • 250g chocolate chips  Instructions: 1) Melt the butter in a small saucepan over medium-low heat, stirring every 15 seconds. The butter will melt, foam, then turn golden brown with nutty aroma, once cooled, mix with both your sugars  2) Whisk in your egg and vanilla extract 3) Fold in your flour, baking powder, bicarbonate of soda, and a pinch on salt (you may need to use your hands) 4) Mix in your chocolate chips 5) Grab a handful of cookie dough and roll it into a ball Repeat 8-12 times! 6) Place on a baking tray and bake in the oven at 160°C fan for around 15 minutes! Enjoy! :) #cookie #chocolate #bakery #recipes #baking
